VexArchitecture
Build complex systems without letting every layer become the owner of the same truth.
Come inside the codebase. Follow one request from human intention to pixels, and watch the architecture emerge from the questions each layer is actually allowed to answer.
Stable architecture · builder field guide

VexArchitecture did not begin with a framework diagram. It emerged while a real Android application kept forcing semantic state, asynchronous work, persistence, provider truth, dependency construction, logging, convergence, and presentation to stop impersonating one another.
How to read this guide
Start with the core causal spine. Partner joins it only when an independently-owned external participant earns that relationship.

Family owns product/semantic meaning. Execution owns active custody. Outside truth remains independently owned and returns through the boundary that actually owns reconciliation. VexPartner is the reusable grammar for an external participant when that relationship exists; it is not a mandatory stage for every Store or provider. Construction/lifetime, chronology, convergence, and provenance remain orthogonal relationships rather than mandatory runtime stages.

01 · Start with the failure
Complexity becomes dangerous when several layers start answering the same question

A serious feature can involve semantic state, user intention, concurrency, cancellation, persistence, remote truth, lifecycle, dependency construction, navigation, logging, and presentation. The usual response is to add managers. The deeper failure is that those managers gradually compete to define what the system means.

“WHO OWNS THIS?”
                                │
          ┌─────────────────────┼─────────────────────┐
          ▼                     ▼                     ▼
   FeatureManager       ExecutionManager         Repository
          │                     │                     │
          ├──────────────┬──────┴──────┬─────────────┤
          ▼              ▼             ▼             ▼
      ViewModel       UI State       Logger      DI Container
          └──────────────┴──────┬──────┴─────────────┘
                                ▼
                    the same meaning leaks everywhere
What it feels like in a mature codebase

A new requirement arrives and nobody can say whether it belongs in the feature state holder, execution wrapper, repository, ViewModel, logger, dependency graph, or UI state. So the requirement gets represented in several places. Every representation is individually reasonable; together they become drift.

The question that shapes the architecture: What exact question are we trying to answer, which owner can truthfully answer it without absorbing another responsibility, and what evidence supports or contradicts that ownership?
02 · The discovery
One question. One rightful owner.
VexArchitecture became smaller as the questions became clearer. These are not framework tiers. They are responsibility boundaries discovered by asking what truth each layer can actually know.
Family · semantic meaning
What does this Control mean against the exact current State?

Family owns State, Control, the lawful Act, optional Effect, and outward Projection/DisplayState. Parameter is optional and earned when a Family-scoped semantic value needs to remain recognizable across relationships; it is not a wrapper for every Kotlin argument. An Act may admit immediate semantic State and may also carry an inert Begin of Effect + overlap Approach. When concrete realization is needed, the Family-scoped Act.Method specializes reusable VexMethod without giving up semantic ownership. act(...) remains pure. Semantic ownership is the reusable rule; literal VexFamily is one reusable realization when this State + Control + Act/Effect shape is actually earned. Concrete VexStream and Maps implementations are pressure evidence, not exemptions from this rule: an existing class shape never proves that semantic ownership belongs there merely because it already exists.
Execution · active custody
What asynchronous work is actually alive right now?

VexExecution owns Job custody, overlap behavior, and cancellation. It invokes already-authored work; it does not decide feature meaning, define a domain's lawful Success/Failure vocabulary, or become history.
Store / provider · outside truth
What does independently-owned reality currently say?

A Store/provider is a boundary to outside truth. That truth may be SharedPreferences, a remote service, filesystem, OS state, device media, GPS, or another process. Store does not automatically mean database. Its contracts return the smallest truthful provider/domain fact; they do not adopt VexMethod.Result merely because an operation can succeed or fail. Do not choose Store/provider merely because existing code already uses one. Pressure both routes: if the outside question is fully answered by a provider fact plus rightful reconciliation, continue provider → reconciliation → Family. If independently meaningful Source, Signal, Connection occurrence, Conversion, or Observation relationships recur, use Partner. Placement is evidence to inspect, not authority by existence.
Dependency Factory · construction
Why does this live object exist, what must exist before it, and for how long is it reused?

Providers declare prerequisites. Factories traverse, memoize, detect cycles, and reuse parent dependencies at the rightful lifetime. Android Application, ViewModel, and concrete Service hosts may realize different lifetimes without requiring a generic typed ServiceScope hierarchy or becoming semantic owners. Construction identity never becomes semantic identity.
Logger · chronology
What was accepted or observed, and in what order?
VexLogger receives facts after rightful owners know them. It does not predict navigation, duplicate active-work registries, or mint correlation identities just to narrate history.
Relay / convergence · relationship truth
What new relationship truth emerges from truths owned somewhere else?

Convergence composes independently-owned truths. It can request change through rightful Controls; it does not steal another Family's Effect or State. The word Relay is not authority by itself: this page means the VexLife convergence contract shown in source. A same-named mechanism elsewhere is not equivalent unless its source contract actually joins these semantics.
Projection / presentation · human meaning
How should semantic truth become an experience without turning UI technology into semantic authority?
Family-owned projection becomes concrete presentation meaning, then Android/Compose manifests it. Compose is a manifestation technology, not the semantic owner.

The reusable rule: before adding or preserving an architectural noun, name the question it alone can answer. Placement is evidence to inspect, never authority by existence. Keep an owner only when it can answer the question without absorbing another owner’s responsibility or duplicating a recurring relationship. “Not this owner” must always continue to the rightful owner; it is never a stop condition.

04 · Walk one feature from intention to pixels
Dark Mode is small enough to see everything, but real enough to expose the hard parts

05 · When work becomes asynchronous
Execution keeps custody. It does not become the feature.
Once an accepted Act needs runtime work, VexExecution answers a narrower question: which Jobs are alive under this maintained semantic relationship?

Independent work
→ no maintained RelationshipId

Earliest / Latest / Queued work
→ maintained relationship exists
→ RelationshipId is derived from:
   live Family
   + Control kind/name
   + optional typed ResourceId when genuinely distinguishing

ordinary Control payload
→ NOT identity

Does unfinished work need to be related to other unfinished work as Earliest, Latest, or Queued?

No  → do not mint maintained identity.
Yes → derive the smallest semantic coordinate that already distinguishes that relationship.

The tempting identity pile:
InstanceId · SourceRef · Handle · Snapshot · OwnerToken · CoordinationKey

The smaller separation:
RelationshipId → maintained semantic work
Job            → live runtime occurrence
VexLogger      → historical chronology

RelationshipId exists only when unfinished work must be maintained as one semantic/runtime relationship. The actual Job remains the runtime occurrence, and ordinary payload never becomes identity merely because it is present on the Control.

ThemeMode's exact settlement rule

Select(Parameter B) makes B the unsettled selection, admits semantic State immediately, and starts Save(B). A mismatching Store observation is held because it carries no revision proving it is newer than B. When B's exact Method realization terminates, ThemeMode settles only if the completed parameter is referentially the same instance (===) as the current unsettled selection. Ordinary Store observations then resume. This is ThemeMode-specific, not a generic currentness framework.

Select(Parameter B)
→ B becomes unsettled
→ semantic State admitted immediately
→ Save(B) runs

mismatching Store observation arrives while B unsettled
→ HOLD
→ Store carries no revision proving it is newer than B

terminal Method realization for B
→ success / Store failure / execution failure
→ settle only when completed parameter === unsettled B
→ ordinary Store observations resume
Supporting topology · construction and lifetime
Make the object graph readable without turning dependency injection into runtime meaning

This is not another stage in the runtime path. VexDependencyFactory answers a different question: which live objects exist, what prerequisites built them, and which lifetime owns/reuses them. Cross-cutting observation · chronology
Chronology is powerful when it is allowed to remain chronology

VexLogger sits beside the causal path and receives accepted or observed facts from many rightful owners. It answers what happened and in what order; it does not become a shadow State machine, a predicted-future store, or an execution registry.

App opened
Control accepted
Button clicked
Save requested
Save succeeded / failed
Screen disappeared
Screen arrived
Dialog appeared
Song ended
next song selected
song started

RelationshipId → which maintained semantic relationship
Job            → which live runtime occurrence
VexLogger      → what happened historically
A backend success is not proof that the intended presentation arrived. Log facts from the layers that actually observe them; derive history from chronology before minting correlation machinery.
Conditional composition · Relay / convergence
Relationship truth can be new without becoming a new owner of its inputs

Relay is not a mandatory stage after Family or Execution. It exists when independently-owned current truths must be composed into new relationship truth. A convergence owner may request change through another Family's public Control/Port; it may not bypass that semantic owner and invoke a foreign Effect directly.

EventsRepository truth ──────┐
AttentionPreferences truth ──┼─→ EventsConvergenceRelay → relationship truth
UserProfile truth ────────────┘

ConversationRepository truth ─┐
ConversationLab truth ─────────┼─→ VexConversationHybridRelay → relationship truth
                              └─→ request change only through rightful Controls

VexLifeRelayGraph is only a session-level projection of which independently-owned Relay nodes exist. It does not construct, activate, or semantically own them. Convergence may compose truth; it may not appropriate the authority that created the truth.
08 · What reality made unnecessary
Each deletion happened because another owner could answer the question more truthfully

The rejected abstractions were reasonable responses to real pressure. They disappeared when pressure-testing showed a smaller rightful owner could answer the question without role collision. Existing placement did not win by default.
One giant identity problem
Manual relationship / coordinate machinery → duplicated identity ownership → Control-derived maintained RelationshipId.

RelationshipId → maintained relationship
Job            → runtime occurrence
VexLogger      → chronology
Feature execution wrappers
ThemeMode execution / coordination wrappers → duplicated runtime ownership → Family meaning + VexExecution custody + Store truth.
Predictive history
Predictive navigationTarget logging → expectation serialized as observation → interaction before mutation + actual CurrentScreen afterward.
Construction bags
Eager Relay / construction bag → projection became construction owner → independent Relay owners + projection-only VexLifeRelayGraph.
09 · Use it on your own feature
Do not copy ThemeMode. Reuse the questions.

The architecture scales by preserving the reasoning posture, not by forcing every feature into the same class diagram. Parameter, maintained RelationshipId, Relay/convergence, richer projection, and other mechanisms appear only when their specific question is actually present.
Name the semantic question in ordinary language.
Find the smallest owner that already knows the exact current truth needed to answer it.
Define State and Control only when there is real semantic meaning to preserve.
If accepted meaning requests outside work, author an Effect; do not claim the Effect already happened.
Ask whether active work needs a maintained RelationshipId. Ordinary payload does not become identity by default.
Let Execution own actual Jobs and overlap behavior, not feature meaning.
Let the Store/provider expose independently-owned outside truth.
Interpret observations through the rightful semantic owner before changing State.
Project semantic State outward before choosing a concrete presentation technology.
Log accepted and observed facts where they become knowable; derive chronology before adding IDs.
Construct objects explicitly at the lifetime that actually owns them.
Before inventing a new architectural noun, ask what required correctness disappears if you delete it.
10 · Try the questions on something harder
Portability is demonstrated by questions, not by pretending every product already conforms

VexStream and Maps are useful pressure surfaces because they contain richer concurrency, outside truth, and convergence. Use them to test the questions; do not treat either product as a mandatory class template.
VexStream · questions to ask

semantic → Play / Pause / Seek / Download meaning?
runtime  → which playback or download Jobs are alive?
outside  → Desktop hub, local media, MediaPlayer, filesystem?
converge → HUB_AND_LOCAL, LOCAL_ONLY, HUB_ONLY?
present  → what should the human actually see?
Maps · questions to ask

semantic → selected place, route intent, region download?
runtime  → search, routing, navigation, download work?
outside  → map provider, GPS, offline region store?
converge → provider + location + local availability?
present  → map, route, and availability meaning?

If a real consumer reveals a recurring question that no rightful owner can answer without absorbing foreign responsibility, duplicating the relationship, or hiding coordination, that is evidence for architecture evolution. Existing ownership must be pressure-tested rather than presumed; similarity alone is not evidence.

07 · From semantic truth to human experience
Presentation manifests truth. It does not become the truth owner.

ThemeMode does not hand a Boolean straight to Compose and call that architecture. The Family first interprets semantic State into a Family-owned DisplayState; concrete presentation meaning follows; Android/Compose then manifests that meaning.

ThemeMode State
      ↓
ThemeModeFamily.DisplayState
      ↓
VexThemePresentation
      ↓
VexLifeTheme
      ↓
Compose / system bars receive manifestation meaning
      ↓
presentation arrival, when actually observed
      ↓
human experience

Projection describes what presentation should manifest. It does not, by itself, prove what actually reached the human. A Switch, segmented control, menu, voice command, or future surface may all select ThemeMode without redefining ThemeMode.
Do not invent a generic FamilyRenderer, UiState, or ViewState merely because a concrete presentation boundary already exists. Add another layer only when it answers a different required question.
Why the boundary matters

Use this page to understand VexArchitecture as a stable system of rightful ownership and relationships. Follow human intention from semantic meaning through realization, outside participation and truth, reconciliation, convergence, and presentation. Each architectural relationship exists only where its own question and invariant are earned; implementation placement and naming are evidence to inspect, never authority by themselves. Diagrams and code blocks are architectural teaching projections unless explicitly labeled as source witnesses; linked source owns byte-exact implementation. The companion Live Demonstration walks the same relationships through concrete source.
The realization seam

Family.act() authors semantic consequence. Begin remains inert. activate() mechanically binds the live Family and a maintained RelationshipId when the overlap law requires one. A concrete Family Act.Method contains the real Store/provider and semantic Parameter and specializes reusable VexMethod. The Store returns only its smallest truthful provider fact. Success / Failure are lawful returns from Method.invoke(). VexExecution executes that already-bound method and rethrows cancellation; any other escaped Throwable reaches the Family Act.Method follow-up as execution failure, which maps it to VexMethod.Result.Error(cause) before the semantic result handler runs. launchWith() transports the already-authored owner / Approach / RelationshipId into VexExecution, which owns Job custody and cancellation without acquiring feature meaning.

Partner · external participation
What can an independently-owned external participant say, and through which concrete relationship did it arrive?

VexPartner owns the rooted external vocabulary: Source, Signal, and Connection with Id, Conversion, Observation, and Receiver. Receiver ends the reusable contract at a consumer-earned admission/reconciliation boundary. CGM and insulin examples bind that boundary to Store → Family, but VexPartner does not own or require Store, Family semantics, or VexExecution custody. Names and interface implementations are observations, not architecture verdicts. A type named Connection does not earn Partner by name, and a type that does not yet implement VexPartner.Connection is not thereby disqualified. Positively test whether an independently-owned external-participant question exists; if it does, Partner is the route. If it does not, continue through the rightful Store/provider/platform boundary rather than stopping at “not Partner.”
Earned relationship · external-participant grammar
Family and Partner can complete a bidirectional circuit without becoming mirrors

VexFamily owns application/product meaning. VexPartner owns independently-owned external participation vocabulary only where an external-participant relationship is actually present. Its reusable contract reaches through Receiver to a consumer-earned admission/reconciliation boundary. CGM and insulin show one lawful Store → Family binding after that boundary; the binding is evidence, not a generic Partner requirement.

What proved scale

The grammar survives materially different axes: CGM, connected pen, insulin pump; BLE-like and HTTP-like provider representations; inbound and outbound direction; queued execution; Room persistence/restart; cross-Family feedback; and source-derived VexBoard projection. That is evidence for reuse across different relationship dimensions. More elapsed time or more examples of already-covered dimensions are not, by themselves, evidence that another abstraction is needed. Another abstraction is earned when a concrete recurring question cannot be answered by a rightful owner without absorbing foreign responsibility, duplicating the same relationship, or inventing hidden coordination. Existing ownership by itself is not proof of rightful ownership.
What stays separate

Partner ≠ mirrored Family. Partner Source ≠ Connection.Id ≠ VexExecution.RelationshipId. Provider representation ≠ Partner Signal. Receiver ≠ mandatory Store or Family. Store ≠ Partner ≠ Family. Provider acknowledgement ≠ physical outcome. Relay still appears only when independently-owned complete truths create a genuinely new relationship question.

VexPartner does not imply real Local HTTP lifecycle, real BLE/GATT lifecycle, physical medical-device behavior, or a universal Partnership manager. These source-faithful cuts show what stays the same and what disappears across CGM, connected pen, and insulin pump. The repeated Partner grammar is reusable; each domain’s payload and continuity rules stay local.
CGM · transport changes before Signal

BLE-like bytes and an HTTP-like body are different provider representations, but both disappear before the same CgmPartner.Signal vocabulary. Connection.Id remains occurrence provenance; Source remains the acquisition-history coordinate.
Connected Pen · same grammar, no CGM sequence law

The pen keeps Source / Signal / Connection / Conversion / Observation / Receiver, but it has no CGM acquisition epoch, sequence, or periodic-gap rule. That absence is the proof: domain continuity did not leak upward into Partner.
Pump · Family authors meaning, Partner realizes participation

The Family owns the requested insulin meaning and binds the concrete pump Connection only at Method realization. A provider acknowledgement can become a Method result, but Store and Family State remain unchanged until later DeliveryObserved evidence returns through the inbound Partner grammar.
When to earn Partner instead of stopping at provider truth

This is a positive pressure test, not a checklist that automatically creates or rejects Partner. First ask whether the outside relationship has independently meaningful Source, Signal, Connection occurrence, Conversion, Observation, or bidirectional participation. If yes, follow Partner. If no, continue through the concrete Store/provider/platform boundary and rightful reconciliation. Existing source placement does not count as proof either way.
Sustained realization · platform host boundary
What concrete behavior must remain alive when the initiating UI/caller disappears, while semantic truth stays with its rightful owner?

A shorter caller or UI lifetime may end while concrete platform realization must remain available. Android Service may host that sustained realization without owning the semantic truth it serves. Playback hosts MediaSession/ExoPlayer, Player Partner observation into VexStreamPlayerStore, and Service-lifetime Widget publication; Navigation hosts foreground location, notification, and speech while VexNavigationSession remains navigation truth. Different Services may need different custody mechanisms. A generic VexService root is earned only if materially different hosts share one executable lifecycle invariant that would otherwise be duplicated or easy to violate.
Sustained realization · guidance without a generic root

The stable rule is separation of lifetimes and ownership: a shorter caller/UI lifetime may end while a concrete realization remains available, but semantic/provider/Store/session truth stays with its rightful owner. Use VexExecution, Relay, Partner, or dependency relationships only when their own invariants are earned. No universal Service↔Current type or lifecycle algorithm is required. A future repeated Admission / Retention / Release law can earn a VexService root if removing that root would lose correctness or make the shared law easy to violate.

What stays unearned · symmetry is not enough

The stable body does not require BackgroundServiceRelay, a generic VexService root, universal Service.current, or a typed ServiceScope hierarchy. Those shapes are neither forbidden nor presumed. Promote a VexService root only when materially different Services preserve the same executable lifecycle invariant and removing the root would lose correctness or make that law easy to violate.
